prompt: Design a vase in OpenSCAD using rotate_extrude on a polygon profile. It is 50 mm tall, 44 mm in outside diameter at the base, tapering to 36 mm outside diameter at the rim, with a 2 mm wall and a 3 mm thick floor. The top is open. Use $fn = 96 for the revolution and keep the profile a single closed polygon that touches the axis at X = 0.
